content: Mutiny binds strictly to loopback addresses like 127.0.0.1.
Default chat operates with tools=None and does not make external network calls.
Saved facts and run records are persisted locally in SQLite tables.
The morning briefing runs locally to summarize notes and scheduled jobs.
Model inference connects only to a locally installed Ollama daemon.
Outbound news monitoring is permanently disabled and cannot browse the web.
The session token is an HttpOnly cookie generated per process run.
Conversation transcripts survive restarts and store full assistant replies.
MemPalace provides optional vector retrieval if local embedding models exist.
Research mode executes closed retrieval over local facts without web access.
Scheduled jobs can be paused, resumed, or stopped in the Jobs drawer.
Custom system personality prompts are preserved across migrations.
